dominant_tripod.rationale: [INF-001] 7,448-yard par-70 layout with two long par-5s and four above-average par-3s creates a structural demand cluster around total driving, aerial approach precision, and scoring on the long holes. This is an architecture-derived inference, not a validated scoring model.
evidence_notes: [DUR-001] Robert Trent Jones Sr. 'hard par, easy bogey' design doctrine
[DUR-002] Aerial-entry elevated bentgrass greens with false-front falloffs
[DUR-003] Deep, long greenside bunkers — marketed as 'longest bunker shots in championship golf'
[INF-002] Two-shot par-5 access conditional on wind/turf firmness — not default birdie holes at this length

tripod_qualified.definition: Approach/long-iron precision, Total Driving, and Par-5/long-par-3 efficiency each at or above 60th percentile versus eligible field.
tripod_qualified.future_candidate_use: Tier 1 support signal — not a stand-alone scoring override

tripod_supported.definition: Weighted tripod score at or above 65th percentile and at least two of three component traits at or above 60th percentile.
tripod_supported.future_candidate_use: Balanced alternative to all-three hard gate

anti_pattern_gate.definition: Short hitter off tee (below-average Total Driving distance) or wild driver (below-average driving accuracy) who cannot compensate with approach precision.
anti_pattern_gate.current_use: Do not score, tier-cap, badge, or suppress any player at this stage
anti_pattern_gate.future_candidate_use: Anti-pattern flag research only — requires multi-event validation

durable_identity.location: [DUR-004] St. Louis, Missouri (Town and Country, MO)
durable_identity.architect_redesign: [DUR-005] Rees Jones with Bryce Swanson — 2006–07 renovation; further 2013 pre-championship preparation work
durable_identity.design_philosophy: [DUR-001] Robert Trent Jones 'hard par, easy bogey' doctrine: length combined with generous-but-crowned fairways, deep flanking bunkers, and large firm greens with sharp false-front falloffs.

off_the_tee.description: [DUR-006] Zoysia fairways on a crowned landing profile pinched by deep laterally-arrayed bunkers; tall fescue rough punishes misses. Par-70 at 7,448 yards makes raw driving distance structurally valuable, but accuracy remains co-required — not a bomb-and-gouge-only track.

approach.description: [DUR-002][DUR-003] Large, firm, elevated bentgrass greens rebuilt as 'fill pad' platforms with sharp false-front falloffs; entry is aerial only. Deep, long greenside bunkers are a documented architectural penalty feature for errant approaches.

approach_distance_skew.inference: 12 of 18 par-4s measure 397+ yards and two par-5s measure 613/624 yards; approach distances skew mid/long-iron rather than wedge-heavy. This is an architecture-derived inference, not an observed SG result.

par_5s.description: [UC-001][INF-002] Two par-5s — hole 8 at 613 yards, hole 17 at 624 yards. Two-shot access is conditional on wind/turf firmness at this length; not default birdie holes.

two_shot_access_inference.inference: At 613 and 624 yards, reachability in two is conditional — not structurally guaranteed. Players who gain scoring access here hold a durable differentiator.

par_3s.description: [UC-001] Four par-3s at 170, 215, 187, and 237 yards — all above-average Tour par-3 length. The 16th at 237 yards is a full long-iron/hybrid test.

long_hole_stress_clustering.inference: The four par-3s average 202 yards, creating a distinct long-iron stress cluster separate from the par-4 grind. Players without reliable long-iron precision face compounding exposure.

terrain.description: [DUR-007] Approximately 190 feet of elevation change concentrated on the back nine, adding uneven-lie and depth-perception difficulty on approach shots.
terrain.setup_sensitivity_note: Exact severity is conditions-dependent; elevation fact is durable, approach difficulty magnitude is setup-sensitive.

placement_demand.inference: Distance-plus-placement co-requirement: the course does not reward pure distance without accuracy. Fairway misses into fescue rough combined with aerial-only elevated greens compound scoring risk for wild drivers in a manner not present at typical bomber-friendly venues.

pure_bomber_punishment.inference: A player generating above-average distance but below-average accuracy faces a structural double-penalty: fescue rough off tee AND longer approach from irregular lies into aerial-only greens. This is architecturally inferred, not statistically validated from Bellerive field data.
